dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel. This is Daniel Koh. We have our arranged discussion now. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rachel. Your objective is regular income and a portfolio that depends less on equities, with enough time to tolerate fluctuations in bond valuations. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for catching my mistake. I will amend my note. For routine correspondence, would you prefer to continue using the secure inbox?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The secure inbox is convenient. I review personal banking correspondence separately from the business paperwork, and I would like to keep that arrangement. Please keep any covering message brief so I can find the relevant document easily.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can keep the covering message concise. Before we finish, how has the gardening been going? You had mentioned taking an interest in it when we last spoke.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: It has been a welcome change from sitting at a desk. I am still learning what grows well in the space, but I enjoy being outside without having to look at a screen. I try not to make it another project with deadlines.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a pleasant break from running the business. I will let you return to your day. Thank you for your time, Rachel.
